## Comparison of burst parameters between STAP and STARR-seq
We want to figure out how promoters and enhancers shape burst parameters 
1) Loading both data sets and merging them to have one data set "dat" that contains all the information 
2) Loading the mu threshold excel file (March 2026)

```{r, echo = FALSE}
#loading data that is required for Fig 3

samples_all <- c(
  "libFL008_E28_RT2_pooledby2",
  "libFL016_E38_e325_pooledby2",
  "libFL017_E38_e339_pooledby2",
  "libFL010_E24_rg_pooledby2", 
  "libFL013_E39_p309_pooledby4", 
  "libFL014_E39_p319_pooledby6"
)

samples_promoter <- c(
  "libFL008_E28_RT2_pooledby2",
  "libFL016_E38_e325_pooledby2",
  "libFL017_E38_e339_pooledby2"
)

samples_enhancer <- c(
  "libFL010_E24_rg_pooledby2", 
  "libFL013_E39_p309_pooledby4", 
  "libFL014_E39_p319_pooledby6"
)

palette_all <- c(
  "libFL008_E28_RT2_pooledby2" = "#1E88E5",
  "libFL016_E38_e325_pooledby2" = "#8CCBFF",
  "libFL017_E38_e339_pooledby2" = "#0B3D91",
  "libFL010_E24_rg_pooledby2" = "#F2994A",
  "libFL013_E39_p309_pooledby4" = "#F7D154",
  "libFL014_E39_p319_pooledby6" = "#B87400"
)

palette_promoter <- palette_all[samples_promoter]
palette_enhancer <- palette_all[samples_enhancer]

columns_to_use <- c(
  "seq_ID", "sample", "condition", "experiment", "library", "rep",
  "bfreq", "bsize", "exp", "log2FoldChange", "full_prec2", "high_mu",
  "filter1", "filter2", "bfreq.thres", "bsize.thres", "KS_pval"
)

STAP_annotated <- readRDS("/groups/stark/lorbeer/Burst_params_DG/STAP_March2025_pools/STAP_annotated_Fig1_compiled_v2.rds")
STARR_annotated <- readRDS("/groups/stark/lorbeer/Burst_params_DG/STARR_March2025_pools/STARR_annotated_log2FC.rds")

dat <- rbind(
  STAP_annotated[, columns_to_use, with = FALSE],
  STARR_annotated[, columns_to_use, with = FALSE]
)

mu_thresholds <- read_xlsx("/groups/stark/lorbeer/Burst_params_DG/mu_thresholds_v2_Reyna.xlsx")

# sanity check: threshold table should be unique by merge key
dup_keys <- mu_thresholds %>%
  count(sample, experiment, library) %>%
  filter(n > 1)

stopifnot(nrow(dup_keys) == 0)

dat <- merge(dat, mu_thresholds, by = c("sample", "experiment", "library"), all.x = TRUE)

# do not overwrite existing high_mu silently
dat[, high_mu_march2026 := exp >= mu_threshold_nofilter]

dat_base <- dat %>%
  filter(
    KS_pval > 0.01,
    high_mu_march2026 == TRUE,
    sample %in% samples_all
  )

```


```{r, echo = FALSE}
plot_param_vs_exp <- function(df, param, exp_on_x = FALSE, show_points = FALSE,
                              sample_levels, palette_vals,
                              xlim = NULL, ylim = NULL, title_text = NULL) {
  
  df_plot <- df %>%
    filter(.data[[param]] > 0, exp > 0) %>%
    mutate(sample = factor(sample, levels = sample_levels))
  
  if (exp_on_x) {
    p <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = log10(exp), y = log10(.data[[param]])))
  } else {
    p <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = log10(.data[[param]]), y = log10(exp)))
  }
  
  if (show_points) {
    p <- p + geom_point(aes(color = sample), alpha = 0.25, na.rm = FALSE)
  }
  
  p +
    geom_smooth(
      aes(color = sample, fill = sample),
      method = "lm",
      formula = y ~ x,
      se = TRUE,
      alpha = 0.2,
      na.rm = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = palette_vals) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = palette_vals) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = xlim, ylim = ylim) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 15) +
    labs(
      x = if (exp_on_x) "log10(mean expression)" else paste0("log10(", param, ")"),
      y = if (exp_on_x) paste0("log10(", param, ")") else "log10(mean expression)",
      title = title_text
    )
}


```


```{r, echo = FALSE}
summarize_lm_direction <- function(df, param, exp_on_x = TRUE) {
  df_model <- df %>%
    filter(exp > 0, .data[[param]] > 0) %>%
    mutate(
      x = if (exp_on_x) log10(exp) else log10(.data[[param]]),
      y = if (exp_on_x) log10(.data[[param]]) else log10(exp)
    ) %>%
    filter(is.finite(x), is.finite(y))
  
  df_model %>%
    group_by(sample) %>%
    do({
      m <- lm(y ~ x, data = .)
      tibble(
        intercept    = coef(m)[["(Intercept)"]],
        slope        = coef(m)[["x"]],
        intercept_se = coef(summary(m))[1, "Std. Error"],
        slope_se     = coef(summary(m))[2, "Std. Error"],
        slope_p      = coef(summary(m))[2, "Pr(>|t|)"],
        r2           = summary(m)$r.squared,
        adj_r2       = summary(m)$adj.r.squared,
        sigma        = summary(m)$sigma,
        nobs         = length(m$fitted.values)
      )
    }) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    arrange(sample)
}


```

```{r, echo = FALSE}
prep_plot_data <- function(df, param, sample_levels) {
  df %>%
    filter(
      sample %in% sample_levels,
      exp > 0,
      .data[[param]] > 0
    ) %>%
    mutate(sample = factor(sample, levels = sample_levels))
}

make_fit_plot <- function(df, param, exp_on_x = FALSE, show_points = FALSE,
                          sample_levels, palette_vals,
                          xlim = NULL, ylim = NULL,
                          title_text = NULL, legend = "none") {
  
  df_plot <- prep_plot_data(df, param, sample_levels)
  
  if (exp_on_x) {
    p <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = log10(exp), y = log10(.data[[param]])))
  } else {
    p <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = log10(.data[[param]]), y = log10(exp)))
  }
  
  if (show_points) {
    p <- p + geom_point(aes(color = sample), alpha = 0.25)
  }
  
  p +
    geom_smooth(
      aes(color = sample, fill = sample),
      method = "lm",
      formula = y ~ x,
      se = TRUE,
      alpha = 0.2
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = palette_vals) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = palette_vals) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = xlim, ylim = ylim) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 15) +
    theme(legend.position = legend) +
    labs(
      title = title_text,
      x = if (exp_on_x) "log10(mean expression)" else paste0("log10(", param, ")"),
      y = if (exp_on_x) paste0("log10(", param, ")") else "log10(mean expression)"
    )
}

summarize_lm_direction <- function(df, param, exp_on_x = TRUE, sample_levels) {
  df_model <- prep_plot_data(df, param, sample_levels) %>%
    mutate(
      x = if (exp_on_x) log10(exp) else log10(.data[[param]]),
      y = if (exp_on_x) log10(.data[[param]]) else log10(exp)
    ) %>%
    filter(is.finite(x), is.finite(y))
  
  df_model %>%
    group_by(sample) %>%
    do({
      m <- lm(y ~ x, data = .)
      tibble(
        intercept    = coef(m)[["(Intercept)"]],
        slope        = coef(m)[["x"]],
        intercept_se = coef(summary(m))[1, "Std. Error"],
        slope_se     = coef(summary(m))[2, "Std. Error"],
        slope_p      = coef(summary(m))[2, "Pr(>|t|)"],
        r2           = summary(m)$r.squared,
        adj_r2       = summary(m)$adj.r.squared,
        sigma        = summary(m)$sigma,
        nobs         = length(m$fitted.values)
      )
    }) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(sample = factor(sample, levels = sample_levels)) %>%
    arrange(sample)
}

fmt_p <- function(p) {
  case_when(
    is.na(p)   ~ "p = NA",
    p < 1e-4   ~ "p < 0.0001",
    p < 1e-3   ~ "p < 0.001",
    TRUE       ~ paste0("p = ", scales::number(p, accuracy = 0.001))
  )
}

plot_slopes <- function(stats_df, palette_vals, title_text, y_label) {
  ymax <- max(stats_df$slope + stats_df$slope_se, na.rm = TRUE)
  ymin <- min(stats_df$slope - stats_df$slope_se, na.rm = TRUE)
  label_offset <- 0.05 * max(ymax - ymin, 0.1)
  
  ggplot(stats_df, aes(x = sample, y = slope, fill = sample)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.8) +
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(ymin = slope - slope_se, ymax = slope + slope_se),
      width = 0.2
    ) +
    geom_text(
      aes(y = slope + slope_se + label_offset, label = fmt_p(slope_p)),
      size = 4,
      vjust = 0
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = palette_vals, guide = "none") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 15) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1, vjust = 1)) +
    labs(
      title = title_text,
      x = "Sample",
      y = y_label
    )
}
```
